summary: National Grid plc filed a Form 6-K on 3 June 2026 announcing that Non-executive Director Jonathan Silver will not stand for re-election at the AGM on 14 July 2026, stepping down at its conclusion after seven years of service. Chair Paula Reynolds thanked him, citing his energy-sector and government experience. This is a routine board departure disclosed under UK Listing Rule 6.4.6(R), not a forced or abrupt change constituting a special situation. No transaction, strategic review, activist campaign, or governance battle is referenced.
